_meta.description: Boolean filtering on the all_types.pulse packed_bool active field via FILTER_TRUE (keep rows where active is logical true). Strict mode (no Values entry) is the canonical packed_bool path. The sibling FILTER_FALSE is exercised in a separate compose-style request shape; both share the boolFilterer implementation and accept Values=["truthy"] for JavaScript-style coercion on non-bool columns.
_meta.name: filter_truthiness
